name: The New York Times
description: Premium news publisher executing a client-side Prebid.js wrapper. Holds the first-party audience data and owns the page, the CMP implementation, and the ad server tag.

name: CNN
description: Global news publisher participating in header bidding with multiple SSP bidders and a server-side ad server integration.

name: The Guardian
description: UK news publisher operating under GDPR with a strict TCF v2.2 consent flow and a transparency-first seller declaration.

name: OneTrust
description: Consent Management Platform generating IAB TCF v2.2 consent strings and Google Consent Mode v2 signals. Resolves the consent state before any bid request is assembled.

name: Usercentrics Cookiebot
description: CMP that scans vendor lists and returns per-vendor consent, allowing bidders to be selectively excluded rather than blocking the whole auction.

name: Quantcast Choice
description: Privacy-preserving consent platform distributing real-time audience segments and consent signals to downstream measurement partners.

name: Permutive
description: Privacy-safe audience platform generating on-device first-party cohorts and Seller-Defined Audiences (SDA), injected into `ortb2.user.data` without exposing raw user data to the seller.

name: LiveRamp RampID
description: Identity resolution provider mapping first-party IDs to the pseudonymous RampID envelope, enabling frequency capping and audience matching across exchanges.

name: Prebid SharedID
description: Open-source first-party ID module. Stores an EUID in a first-party cookie and sends it as a user ID module bid parameter, improving DSP-side match rates without a third-party cookie.

name: Magnite
description: Supply-Side Platform running the header bidding auction and the exchange. Applies price floors, enforces deal precedence, and returns the winning bid to the ad server.

name: PubMatic
description: Supply-Side Platform with a header bidding wrapper and first-party data segment marketplace. Publishes one of the most widely adopted sellers.json files.

name: OpenX
description: Supply-Side Platform specialising in curated private marketplace deals, header bidding passthrough, and supply-path transparency via the `schain` object.

name: Index Exchange
description: Supply-Side Platform known for its independent exchange design and strong publisher-side yield tooling.

name: Adform
description: Supply-Side Platform offering DSP-to-SSP direct deals (Deals), creative scanning, and supply-path validation.

name: Smart AdServer
description: Supply-Side Platform with a strong European footprint and built-in video marketplace integrations.

name: The Moneytizer
description: Content-monetisation SSP pairing contextual classification with brand-safety filters before the auction runs.

name: Adman Media
description: Independent SSP operating curated PMP deals and direct premium inventory partnerships.

name: Yieldmo
description: Independent SSP running the Yieldmo Direct marketplace for one-to-one premium brand inventory.

name: The Trade Desk
description: Demand-Side Platform buying across the open internet. Evaluates each impression in a few milliseconds and returns a CPM bid, optionally restricted to PMP deal IDs.

name: Google DV360
description: Google’s enterprise DSP. Participates in the auction through the OpenRTB endpoint and competes with Google Ad Manager for the same impression.

name: Amazon DSP
description: Retail-media DSP bidding on commerce intent signals. Typically bids conservatively on general news inventory.

name: Criteo
description: Retargeting and commerce-focused DSP with a large CTV and e-commerce footprint, using first-party basket signals for bid valuation.

name: Casale Media
description: Premium brand-safety DSP focused on contextual and private inventory, commonly invoked in PMP-only auctions.

name: Sharethrough
description: Contextual, standard-supply DSP requiring a publisher-registered domain or seller declaration before bidding.

name: Smaato
description: Mobile-first DSP with supply-path optimisation across app and mobile-web environments.

name: Google Ad Manager
description: Ad server arbitrating between a direct-sold line item and the winning header bidding bid, passed via key-values such as `hb_pb`. Direct campaigns have configured priority.

name: Mock Ad Server
description: Synthetic ad server used in this simulator to demonstrate arbitration without involving any real campaign delivery.

name: Integral Ad Science
description: Post-bid measurement and verification tag. Executes after the ad renders to measure viewability (MRC/OMID), classify brand safety, and estimate invalid traffic (IVT).
